title: Noor and the Deadline
author: A. M. Joubert
blurb: Gideon Iversen, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, works cases no one wants attributed. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
